personal.name: PANKAJ KUMAR
personal.title: Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead
personal.summary: Accomplished Senior .NET Developer with over 12 years of experience architecting, engineering, and scaling high-performance enterprise applications and cloud-native solutions. Proven expert in C#, .NET 10, Azure serverless microservices, and high-concurrency APIs powering critical UK public infrastructure and financial systems. Track record of successfully leading cross-functional Agile teams, modernizing complex legacy platforms, and optimizing database performance.

bullets: Architected and deployed cloud-native serverless Azure Function microservices (C# / .NET 10) powering the TfL Go mobile app backend, serving real-time journey planning and status updates to millions of daily active commuters.
Engineered high-throughput Cosmos DB data models and custom partition key strategies, maintaining sub-second API response latencies during peak concurrency.
Developed and enhanced core modules for Personal and Fleet AutoPay platforms handling Congestion Charge, LEZ, and ULEZ compliance.
Spearheaded the end-to-end modernization and migration of 20+ legacy components to .NET 10, achieving a 25% reduction in cloud compute costs and accelerating throughput.
Led root-cause analysis and complex technical troubleshooting across mission-critical transport infrastructure, consistently meeting strict enterprise SLAs.
Engineered scalable, high-availability software solutions within an Agile team supporting core insurance platforms.
Modernized 20+ legacy backend components of the Broker platform to .NET 6, decreasing transaction processing latency by 30% and eliminating technical debt.
Designed and implemented custom operational reporting solutions for broker intermediaries, boosting overall operational efficiency by ~10%.
Served as Technical Lead guiding cross-functional onshore and offshore engineering teams in delivering financial application services for Nationwide MDC.
Architected robust, scalable backend services utilizing .NET Core, WCF, and SQL Server to process core banking, mortgage, and savings workflows.
Established comprehensive technical documentation and system architecture guidelines, cutting new engineer onboarding time by 40%.
Monitored production environments periodically to identify performance bottlenecks and execute targeted refactoring initiatives.
Supervised a team of 5 software engineers during a full-scale architectural overhaul of flagship SaaS applications, directly driving a 33% increase in annual revenue.
Partnered with technical executives during client presentations to define architectural roadmaps, securing over $120K in new enterprise contracts.
Optimized complex database queries, indexes, and stored procedures in MSSQL to maximize application throughput and responsiveness.
Designed and built a custom Customer Resolution Management platform using .NET MVC and jQuery, accelerating client issue resolution cycles by 25%.
Maintained and expanded core features for point-of-sale (POS) MIS systems built on ASP.NET C# and VB.
Enhanced front-end UI performance and cross-browser compatibility using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and AJAX.
